design_philosophy: The UI must feel like a precision instrument for a logistics control room. Banish standard soft SaaS cards. Expose the skeleton with visible grid lines, sharp borders, and stark high-contrast typography. Information density is key, but clarity is paramount.

headings.usage: Use tracking-tight for all headings. Never use Inter for headings. Keep scales strictly within text-xl to text-4xl for the dashboard.

data_and_mono.usage: MANDATORY for Tracking IDs, Order Numbers, Dates, Times, and API Keys. Use uppercase labels with tracking-[0.2em] for table headers and overlines.

layout_and_spacing.global: Mobile-first responsive grids. Generous padding around the main layout but dense data within components.
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts for features. Remove border on the last item to create an open edge.

dashboard_grid.specs: Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-px (if using background grid lines).

components.cards: DO NOT USE default Shadcn rounded cards with shadows. Use flat, sharp rectangular containers (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) with 1px solid border-zinc-200. NO SHADOWS.
components.inputs: Flat, strict rectangles. bg-white border-zinc-200 text-sm. Focus state MUST have high contrast focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-900.
components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-sm). Font-weight medium to bold.
components.tables: Dense. text-sm. Use monospaced font for IDs. Border-b only for rows.
components.modals_dialogs: Flat solid background. No glassmorphism. Sharp borders.

views_and_features_spec.dashboard_home: Top KPI strip (Shipments Today, In Transit, Delivered, Exceptions). Below: Recent Shipments Data Table. Keep it 1-insight-per-scroll.
views_and_features_spec.create_shipment_form: 2-column grid structure (Sender on left, Receiver on right). Clear separation. Use Shadcn form primitives but style them brutally flat.
views_and_features_spec.tracking_view: Vertical stepper timeline for status. Minimalist, high contrast.
views_and_features_spec.api_and_settings: Display the provided API Key (`e77ef181577c1ea451b6f6232c55122062441079`) in a distinct, monospaced read-only block. Provide a 'Copy' button.

empty_state_box.description: Minimalist 3D isometric render of a pristine white shipping box with subtle blue shadows.
empty_state_box.usage: MANDATORY for empty states (e.g., 'No shipments found', 'No tracking data'). Center it, add generous padding, keep it small (max-w-[200px]).

auth_background_pattern.description: Abstract logistics network pattern. Subtle light grey on white.
auth_background_pattern.usage: Use as a background cover for authentication pages or decorative sidebar areas. Overlay with bg-white/50 if needed for text contrast.

logistics_hero_stock.description: Shallow focus photo of a brown cardboard box.
logistics_hero_stock.usage: Use in 'Schedule Pickup' marketing banner or onboarding cards.

technical_and_interaction_rules.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='create-shipment-button'`).
technical_and_interaction_rules.accessibility: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., `hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-white`).
technical_and_interaction_rules.motion: Minimal. Use simple opacity/transform transitions for hover states (0.2s ease). No bouncy or playful animations.
technical_and_interaction_rules.icons: Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react for sharp, precise symbology.
